front: You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with your unarmed attacks. Weapon runes etched into these wraps make your unarmed attacks work like magic weapons.
back:
Invest: meditate while slowly wrapping them around your hands.
+1: +1 item bonus to unarmed attack rolls.
Runes: upgrade, add and transfer them as for a weapon. You can attach talismans. For these purposes the wraps are light Bulk melee weapons of the brawling group.
Property runes apply only if applicable to the unarmed attack used (a slashing-only property doesn't work with a fist, but does with a claw or other slashing unarmed attack).
